meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of burke.
meaning.vi: Thì quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ của burke.

sentences.en: Burke pushed the button and the elevator began its slow ascent.

sentences.en: Burke was asleep, sprawled obliviously against the window.

sentences.en: Mrs Burke was found unconscious and bleeding profusely.

sentences.en: Burke later admitted he had lied.

sentences.en: At that moment he came face to face with Sergeant Burke.

sentences.en: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.

sentences.en: Nigel Burke is a lay legal adviser.

sentences.en: Between this and stories on Burke of the Somme,[sentencedict.com] Chant's death attracted a lot of column inches.
